Style: farmhouse, traditional, retro

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Vintage Black and White Red Wine List, White Frame, 15" x 27"
product.description: This vintage list of red wines is the perfect word art for a wine-lover's wall. The stark contrast of white type on a black background housed in a white frame allows this piece to blend with traditional, modern or even industrial décor. 15"W x 27"H Print on paper in plastic frame with wood texture finish A reproduction of a vintage red wine list Ready to hang, all hardware included
